requested_outcome: Every public slider uses subject-relevant, truthful media and never renders the legacy unavailable-place image.
natural_destination: All public VII slider and carousel families on desktop and 390-pixel mobile.
authorization_boundary: Implementation, tests and release-candidate preparation are authorized. Domain launch or unrelated content changes are outside this correction.

lesson_bundle.reason: The defect is an incorrect public card image and replacement media must preserve identity and truthfulness.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inventory every changed image, its source, semantic fit and illustration label where applicable.

lesson_bundle.reason: The correction must cover the full slider family rather than one homepage row.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: A family-wide source and rendered regression must cover every slider data source.

lesson_bundle.reason: This is a targeted media correction and approved layout, text and interactions must stay unchanged.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Before-and-after review must show only intended media and truthful-label changes.

lesson_bundle.reason: Completion requires the exact public surface and affected-family regression, not only a code edit.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Build, tests, desktop/mobile visual inspection and a precise deployment status are required.

lesson_bundle.reason: This request is a repeated correction and lifecycle hooks are disabled.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The correction is captured directly in the active task contract without claiming hook enforcement.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the two visible homepage cards are fixed while another slider still exposes the unavailable image.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Centralize the banned-media rule and inventory every slider and carousel source.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Repository and rendered-route sweep finds zero use of the banned asset in public slider output.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A generated or unrelated photo is presented as a real venue.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Prefer verified project media and mark thematic fallbacks as illustration rather than business photography.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every fallback has a relevant category mapping and truthful accessible label.

predicted_rejections.rejection: CMS content reintroduces the banned asset after the static default was corrected.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Sanitize persisted presentation data at the read boundary and serialize only approved media.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A regression fixture with the banned image resolves to the category-specific fallback.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The repair changes slider layout, navigation or card copy.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep markup and interaction contracts stable and limit changes to media resolution and labels.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Targeted diff and desktop/mobile comparison show unchanged geometry and controls.

sources.label: User-provided screenshot showing the rejected unavailable-place image

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the central resolver and one homepage rail are wired, before expansion to all slider families.
checks: The banned image resolves to a subject-matched alternative.
A valid approved image remains unchanged.
The card exposes an honest illustration label only when a fallback is used.

attack_questions: Can persisted CMS JSON still force the banned asset into any slider?
Can a query string or absolute legacy URL bypass the banned-media match?
Does any desktop or mobile carousel render the wrong topic image after hydration?
Is any fallback mistaken for a real named business photograph?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Screenshots and DOM/media-source checks on the exact candidate for representative public slider routes at desktop and 390-pixel mobile.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated inventory test covering each slider source plus a repository sweep for banned asset references.

effectiveness.baseline: The legacy unavailable-place asset is referenced by homepage presentation data and can also be restored through persisted CMS slider JSON.
effectiveness.target: Zero banned or semantically mismatched unavailable-place images in all public slider families, including CMS overrides.
